customer: Hi, I'm moving to Georgia for a new job and want to sell my convertible before I go. Last summer the top was down during a storm and the interior got soaked. Will that be a problem for an offer?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on the new job. Per our article "Flood-damaged cars," cars with flood damage or a flood brand on the title count as branded, and we don't buy those. Since water got into the cabin, please be sure to tell us about it when you request an offer.
